embeddedTerminal.localProxyInstallTermsIntro: Read the terms below. First click “Download and save”. After saving, enter the full path you just saved to and check the box to continue.
embeddedTerminal.localProxyInstallTerms:
1) This downloads the BadCase local proxy binary to your device. It is used when you run the web app in a normal browser so the embedded terminal can talk to a local shell. The Electron desktop app uses node-pty instead and does not need this proxy.

2) 【Download & save】Click “Download and save”. The OS Save dialog will appear—save the file to your desired install location.

3) 【Enter the path】After saving, enter the exact full path (including file name) you just saved to below. This path is used only for later hints (we do not auto-edit the registry).

4) 【Manual start】Start the binary on your machine manually, then click “Check again” next to the terminal status. If you have already downloaded it before, you can skip step 2 and just start it and check again.

5) 【Networking】The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8794) for local access only.

6) 【Do not continue if you disagree】If you disagree with any clause, do not check the box or continue.

helpDoc.intro: Below is a concise guide to the project workspace. Use the search box to filter topics by keyword.
helpDoc.noResults: No matching topics. Try different keywords.

sections.title: Workspace overview
paragraphs: Inside a project, the left panel is the iteration plan tree, the center shows lists or editors, the right can host the AI assistant, and the bottom can host the terminal.
The header shows the project name and breadcrumbs; the avatar menu opens Settings, Notifications, and Help (this page).

sections.title: Iteration plan sidebar
paragraphs: Under “Unplanned cards” you can switch among BadCase / Bug / Test case views; “In progress” and “Archived” show the corresponding plans.
Click a plan to select it and load its list in the center; expand/collapse nodes that have children.
The sidebar header may offer refresh, create plan, baseline tools, etc. (follow on-screen buttons).

sections.title: Center tabs and lists
paragraphs: The tab strip above the main area opens plan lists, embedded editors, create tabs, Settings, Help, etc., as workbench tabs—not browser tabs.
Click a tab title to focus it; click × to close. Closing the active tab activates a neighbor; closing all restores a default list tab based on the sidebar selection.
The “⋯” menu lists open tabs and may offer “Close all”.

sections.title: Filters and create
paragraphs: Use the search box and filters such as assignee and status to narrow the current plan’s list.
“New BadCase / Bug / Test case” opens a new workbench tab so you stay inside the project; after save or close, continue in the list.

sections.title: Row details and confirmations
paragraphs: Rows can expand to show detail fields. Pending edits or create previews show inline actions to confirm or cancel.
Consecutive related changes may appear as a group with group-level confirm/cancel.

sections.title: Header layout toggles
paragraphs: The three icons on the right toggle: left plan sidebar, bottom terminal panel, and right AI assistant.
You can usually resize the terminal and assistant by dragging splitters (when shown).

sections.title: Terminal and local proxy
paragraphs: Running Agent shell commands from the browser may require a local helper process; the Electron desktop build often uses a built-in channel instead.
If the UI reports the proxy is missing, follow the in-app instructions to download/start it, then retry.

sections.title: AI assistant
paragraphs: The right panel supports Q&A and Agent flows; it may deep-link into lists or suggest edits depending on product version.
Use Stop to interrupt streaming output; session history follows whatever entry points the UI exposes.

sections.title: Settings and account
paragraphs: Avatar → Settings opens a Settings tab: account & subscription, team management, and language preferences.
AI credits are tied to your account; click Save after changing language.

sections.title: Notifications
paragraphs: Notifications in the avatar menu opens the workbench “Notifications” tab to search in-app records for this project (same store as email / IM CLIs).

sections.title: More tips
paragraphs: If the list and sidebar disagree, refresh plans or re-enter the project.
“Edit permission” labels are informational; contact a project admin if actions are blocked.
